text: 2:13 that's funny, the only quad I ever lost used this Matek GPS, home arrow took me in a wrong direction and battery ran out and the final coordinates my goggles and radio were showing after it crashed were a good 20 km off 😅 Since then I only fly long range along visually distinct lines/curves/points that I can trace by foot. Sure I still use GPS, but rescue mode is off and so is the arrow, I only use coordinates, speed and elevation. I verify coordinates before every takeoff using my phone to make sure they are correct too. Anyway a good person found my quad 5 months later and was able to track me down using the GoPro footage ❤️ and after cleaning up a bunch of corrosion (motors were the hardest), everything works now for 7-8 months. Moral of the story is don't trust technology 100% and always have a backup plan 🙂
